projects.title: Roof & Window Leak Repairs
projects.description: After identifying persistent leaks from heavy rains, we quickly responded by assessing the flashing and replacing damaged decking. Upgraded the area with new architectural shingles.
projects.review: Will McCann from McCannical Roofing is my favorite 'go-to' guy for anything roof. His crew was fast and clean!

projects.title: Class 3 GAF Timberline HDZ (Oyster Gray)
projects.description: This client reached out after purchasing this beautiful home in Hudson Bend. They needed a full roof replacement due to storm damage and wind exposure. We upgraded them to GAF Timberline HDZ in Oyster Gray.
projects.review: We had an outstanding experience with McCannical Roofing. They handled everything with our insurance adjuster and got it done.

projects.title: Residential Reroof & Siding Paint
projects.description: Full tear-off and replacement of asphalt shingles on a two-story home. In addition to the roof replacement, we repaired the external siding and applied premium weather-resistant paint.
projects.review: I had my roof replaced due to storm damage & was so pleased had them do the outside of the house painting as well.

projects.title: Storm Damage Repair & Inspection
projects.description: Assessed severe hail damage on a residential property. Facilitated the insurance adjustment process and completed the roof repair including replacement of multiple ridge caps and vent flashing.
projects.review: Will and his crew were awesome to deal with start to finish on our project. They were professional and fast.

projects.title: Commercial Flat Roof Coating
projects.description: Applied commercial silicone flat roof coating system to stop minor leaks and improve energy efficiency. The reflective white coating helps lower building cooling costs by up to 20%.
projects.review: We had a great experience working with McCannical Roofing and the team. Highly recommend them for any roof repairs.

projects.title: Gutter Replacement & Leaf Protection
projects.description: Installed new 6-inch seamless aluminum gutters and downspouts. Added premium leaf filter guards to prevent future clogging and ensure proper drainage away from the home's foundation.
projects.review: Will and his crew do awesome work. They got things done quickly and left the yard cleaner than they found it.

projects.title: Lakefront Home Custom Slate Roof
projects.description: Restored a beautiful slate roof on a custom lakefront property. Fixed structural underlayment problems and replaced cracked tiles using color-matched premium natural slate.
projects.review: Will met with the insurance adjuster, took care of all the details, and made the whole roof replacement stress-free.

projects.title: Custom Wood Fencing Installation
projects.description: Designed and built a premium cedar privacy fence for a large backyard. Features heavy-duty posts, double-sided pickets, and custom-welded steel gates to match the property line.
projects.review: We've had our fair share of roof issues over the years, and Will has become our trusted resource. Fast response time!

projects.title: Georgetown Hail Damage Reroof
projects.description: Completed a comprehensive reroof following a major hail storm. Replaced all decking, upgraded the underlayment to synthetic felt, and installed impact-resistant Class 4 architectural shingles.
projects.review: Professional crew. They finished the whole roof in just one day and did a great clean up.

projects.title: Emergency Roof Tarping & Repair
projects.description: Responded within 2 hours to a tree branch impact on a roof. Cleared the debris, installed heavy-duty weatherproofing tarp, and repaired the rafters and deck structural framing the following morning.
projects.review: Saved us from massive water damage! Incredibly fast response.

projects.title: Luxury Metal Standing Seam Roof
projects.description: High-end standing seam metal roof installation on a modern architectural home. Designed for maximum longevity, extreme wind resistance, and modern aesthetics.
projects.review: A masterpiece! The modern metallic look matches our home architecture perfectly.

projects.title: Buda Shingle Repair & Gutters
projects.description: Completed minor roof shingle repair due to high wind damages. Also cleaned, re-aligned, and repaired existing residential gutters to stop siding stains.
projects.review: Very honest assessment, fixed the wind damage quickly for a reasonable price.

projects.title: Kyle Ridge Cap Replacement
projects.description: Replaced worn-out ridge cap shingles on a single family home. Upgraded to high-profile GAF ridge caps to improve ventilation performance and roof aesthetics.
projects.review: Very neat installation. The new ridge caps make the roof look brand new.

projects.title: Dripping Springs Metal Reroof
projects.description: Upgraded a traditional shingle roof to a beautiful dark bronze standing seam metal roof. The metal panels provide unmatched longevity and high energy efficiency for the Texas heat.
projects.review: Absolutely outstanding! The team was super professional and the roof looks amazing.
